name: Living Index A — Split Thesis
prompt: High-fidelity 1600x1000 personal homepage comp in the fixed Living Index world. Restrained horizontal header; first-view split with a 32% identity and orientation column beside a 60% dominant artwork; enough second fold to show dense Selected Work and Recent Writing. Use only real repository labels and titles. Near-white uncoated paper, black ink, cobalt structure, orange narrative event, slate; sculptural display serif, humanist reading sans, narrow metadata sans; print grain and decisive image scale; no dashboard, atlas, cards, glass, gradients, or invented claims.
correction: The first render invented dates in Recent Writing. The preserved comp replaces every date with a neutral placeholder mark.
